content.text:
Use the existing two-column summary: pie on the left, compact top five recipients on the right, replacing the timeline and removing the separate top ten section. `pounds.topRecipients.slice(0, 5)` requires no API change.

Keep the pie above an always two-column legend. Reserve roughly three 48px legend rows; scroll internally for additional parties. This preserves the current 200px pie and gives labels more width than a side legend inside the narrow left column.

For stable rows, show one-line party labels with ellipsis and one short entry-count line; move unavailable-amount counts into the existing tooltip alongside the full party name and amount. Retain complete accessible labels and keyboard/touch interaction.

Pitfalls:

- Never truncate the data to fit the legend; all parties must remain reachable.
- `partyChart` has no six-party limit, so a fixed three-row layout needs overflow.
- Preserve negative/unavailable-total context, ideally beneath the fixed chart area.
- Five recipient rows should retain party affiliation and partial-total indicators without making long names or large amounts overlap.
- Apply fixed sizing on desktop; permit natural height and a single column on narrow screens.
